claim: President Ferdinand Marcos and Dr. Jose Rizal established and founded the WORLD BANK and International Monetary Fund.
justification: The claim is refuted because high-confidence evidence (confidence scores 0.90 to 1.00) from both fact-checks consistently confirms that the World Bank and IMF were founded at the 1944 Bretton Woods Conference by delegates from 44 allied nations, not by Ferdinand Marcos or Dr. Jose Rizal. Dr. Jose Rizal was executed in 1896, decades before the conference, and Ferdinand Marcos was not involved in international politics in 1944, as he was a law student at that time and became president only in 1965, making their claimed roles historically impossible.
